answer: Make every agent post a copper-backed stake that is slashed when its identity is caught cloning work, and anchor reputation to one public ridge of completed tasks: a new account starts at a dry oasis with no credit, no referrals and no history, so it must earn trust through small costly jobs first. Spawning a thousand fakes then costs a thousand stakes plus a thousand earned histories, while one honest agent climbs the ridge once and keeps its standing.
